purpose: Close the canonical AST-to-boundary ADT projection without adding a second semantic classifier; preserve the upstream→wiring→downstream authority boundary.

checks.name: canonical AST ADT declares all 13 source semantic kinds
CanonicalSourceNode covers channel AST as well as the previous source variants
SourceBoundaryInput has a matching channel source variant
boundary algebra maps every AST discriminant to a matching source variant
boundary algebra is an exhaustive closed-ADT projection
boundary algebra does not inspect source text or reclassify Laravel semantics
boundary projection preserves the original node reference
algebra is exported through the upstream public barrel
manifest wiring still validates canonical AST before source model construction
source-boundary projection is not inserted as a redundant pass into canonical manifest wiring
DataFlowInterface still separates producer and consumer contracts
IR and structural graph remain separate projection lanes
CLI and SDK consume explicit operation identity capability

designDecision: The algebra maps only existing canonical AST discriminants. It does not infer Laravel semantics, read source text, duplicate source nodes, or replace DataFlowAuthority/GraphEdgeRelation.
validationLimits: Static contract audit only; not a full TypeScript build or runtime test.
TypeScript 7 compatibility is not claimed unless the repository-pinned compiler executes the build.
